This message is shown when every upload is rejected on row 1 due to column count mismatch. The message could be clarified or extended with additional guidance or details to help users understand and resolve the issue.

The proposed change is to clarify the error message text or add context to help users troubleshoot this problem more effectively, especially since the files themselves appear valid externally.
